data.one_liner: A Flutter date picker widget inspired by the Android Holo Theme.
data.what_it_does: Provides a date picker widget styled after the classic Android Holo Theme. It supports various customization parameters such as divider thickness, diameter ratio, and spacing, and includes localization for many languages.
use_when: You want a date picker with an Android Holo Theme style.
You need a localized date picker supporting many different languages.
avoid_when: You require standard Material or Cupertino style pickers without vintage Holo styling.
You are using a Flutter version older than v3.19.
strengths: Extensive multi-language localization support out of the box.
Offers customization options like divider thickness, spacing, and diameter ratio.
weaknesses: Requires a minimum Flutter version of v3.19 in recent releases.
Limited to a specific niche vintage theme look.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more modern and customizable calendar-style date picker instead of the vintage Holo wheel style.

data.minimal_example:
DateTime? selectedDate = await DatePicker.showSimpleDatePicker(
  context,
  initialDate: DateTime(1994,
      11,
      24),
  firstDate: DateTime(1960),
  lastDate: DateTime(2012),
  locale: DateTimePickerLocale.en_us,
);
